newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 28 OF JANUARY 30, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 28 OF JANUARY 30, 1997.

text.p: Council Regulation (EC) No 118/97 of 2 December 1996 amending and updating Regulation (EEC) No 1408/71 on the application of social security schemes to employed persons, to self-employed persons and to members of their families moving within the Community and Regulation (EEC) No 574/72 laying down the procedure for implementing Regulation (EEC) No 1408/71 END OF DOCUMENT.
